elements.name: Mystic (UA)
elements.desc:
Mystics shun the world to turn their eyes inward, mastering the full potential of their minds and exploring their psyches before turning to face the world. Mystics are incredibly rare, and most prefer to keep the nature of their abilities secret. Using their inner, psychic strength, they can read minds, fade into invisibility, transform their bodies into living iron, and seize control of the physical world and bend it to their will.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 32 — The Mystic Class See the side panel for the full text.

g.d: (a) leather armor or (b) studded leather armor

(a) a scholar's pack or (b) an explorer's pack

elements.name: Order of the Avatar (UA)
elements.desc:
Mystics of the Order of the Avatar delve into the world of emotion, mastering their inner life to such an extent that they can manipulate and amplify the emotions of others with the same ease that an artist shapes clay. Known as Avatars, these mystics vary from tyrants to inspiring leaders who are loved by their followers.

Avatars can bring out extreme emotions in the people around them. For their allies, they can lend hope, ferocity, and courage, transforming a fighting band into a deadly, unified force. For their enemies, they bring fear, disgust, and trepidation that can make even the most hardened veteran act like a shaky rookie.

elements.name: Order of the Awakened (UA)
elements.desc:
Mystics dedicated to the Order of the Awakened seek to unlock the full potential of the mind. By transcending the physical, the Awakened hope to attain a state of being focused on pure intellect and mental energy.

The Awakened are skilled at bending minds and unleashing devastating psionic attacks, and they can read the secrets of the world through psionic energy. Awakened mystics who take to adventuring excel at unraveling mysteries, solving puzzles, and defeating monsters by turning them into unwilling pawns.

elements.name: Order of the Immortal (UA)
elements.desc:
The Order of the Immortal uses psionic energy to augment and modify the physical form. Followers of this order are known as Immortals. They use psionic energy to modify their bodies, strengthening them against attack and turning themselves into living weapons.

Their mastery of the physical form grants them their name, for Immortals are notoriously difficult to kill.

elements.name: Order of the Nomad (UA)
elements.desc:
Mystics of the Order of the Nomad keep their minds in a strange, rarified state. They seek to accumulate as much knowledge as possible, as they quest to unravel the mysteries of the multiverse and seek the underlying structure of all things. At the same time, they perceive a bizarre, living web of knowledge they call the noosphere.

Nomads, as their name indicates, delight in travel, exploration, and discovery. They desire to accumulate as much knowledge as possible, and the pursuit of secrets and hidden lore can become an obsession for them.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Memory of One Thousand Steps (UA)

elements.name: Soul Knife (Mystic UA)
elements.desc:
The Order of the Soul Knife sacrifices the breadth of knowledge other mystics gain to focus on a specific psionic technique. These mystics learn to manifest a deadly weapon of pure psychic energy that they can use to cleave through foes.

Soul knives vary widely in their approach to this path. Some follow it out of a desire to achieve martial perfection. Others are ruthless assassins who seek to become the perfect killer.

Note: This is the Mystic Order from UA 32. It is distinct from the Rogue subclass `Soulknife (UA)` in `Rogue.json` — different class, different mechanics.

elements.name: Order of the Wu Jen (UA)
elements.desc:
The Order of the Wu Jen features some of the most devoted mystics. These mystics seek to lock themselves away from the world, denying the limits of the physical world and replacing it with a reality that they create for themselves. Known as wu jens, these mystics cast their minds into the world, seize control of its fundamental principles, and rebuild it.

In practical terms, wu jens excel at controlling the forces of the natural world. They can hurl objects with their minds, control the four elements, and alter reality to fit their desires.

elements.name: Psionics (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Mystic feature.

As a student of psionics, you can master and use psionic talents and disciplines. Psionics is a special form of magic use, distinct from spellcasting. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Mystical Recovery (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Mystic feature.

Starting at 2nd level, you can draw vigor from the psi energy you use to power your psionic disciplines.

Immediately after you spend psi points on a psionic discipline, you can take a bonus action to regain hit points equal to the number of psi points you spent.

elements.name: Telepathy (UA)
elements.desc:
2nd-level Mystic feature.

At 2nd level, your mind awakens to the ability to communicate via telepathy. You can telepathically speak to any creature you can see within 120 feet of you in this manner. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Strength of Mind (UA)
elements.desc:
4th-level Mystic feature.

Even the simplest psionic technique requires a deep understanding of how psionic energy can augment mind and body. This understanding allows you to alter your defenses to better deal with threats. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Potent Psionics (UA)
elements.desc:
8th-level Mystic feature.

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon attacks with psychic energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage to that target. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Consumptive Power (UA)
elements.desc:
10th-level Mystic feature.

At 10th level, you gain the ability to sacrifice your physical durability in exchange for psionic power. When activating a psionic discipline, you can pay its psi point cost with your hit points, instead of using any psi points. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Mastery (UA)
elements.desc:
11th-level Mystic feature.

Beginning at 11th level, your mastery of psionic energy allows you to push your mind beyond its normal limits. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Body (UA)
elements.desc:
20th-level Mystic feature.

At 20th level, your mastery of psionic power causes your mind to transcend the body. Your physical form is infused with psionic energy. You gain the following benefits: See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bonus Disciplines (Avatar UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Avatar feature.

At 1st level, you learn two additional Psionic Disciplines of your choice. They must be chosen from among the Avatar disciplines. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Armor Training (Avatar UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Avatar feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

elements.name: Avatar of Battle (UA)
elements.desc:
3rd-level Order of the Avatar feature.

Starting at 3rd level, you project an inspiring aura. While you aren't incapacitated, each ally within 30 feet of you who can see you gains a +2 bonus to initiative rolls.

elements.name: Avatar of Healing (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Order of the Avatar feature.

Beginning at 6th level, you project an aura of resilience. While you aren't incapacitated, each ally within 30 feet of you who can see you regains additional hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 0) whenever they regain hit points from a psionic discipline.

elements.name: Avatar of Speed (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Order of the Avatar feature.

Starting at 14th level, you project an aura of speed. While you aren't incapacitated, any ally within 30 feet of you who can see you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

elements.name: Bonus Disciplines (Awakened UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Awakened feature.

At 1st level, you learn two additional Psionic Disciplines of your choice. They must be chosen from among the Awakened disciplines.

Engine note: psionic disciplines are not in this data set yet. Note your chosen Awakened disciplines manually.

elements.name: Awakened Talent (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Awakened feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, and Persuasion.

elements.name: Psionic Investigation (UA)
elements.desc:
3rd-level Order of the Awakened feature.

Starting at 3rd level, you can focus your mind to read the psionic imprint left on an object. If you hold an object and concentrate on it for 10 minutes (as if concentrating on a psionic discipline), you learn a few basic facts about it. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Surge (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Order of the Awakened feature.

Starting at 6th level, you can overload your psychic focus to batter down an opponent's defenses. You can impose disadvantage on a target's saving throw against a discipline or talent you use, but at the cost of using your psychic focus. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Spectral Form (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Order of the Awakened feature.

At 14th level, you gain the ability to become a ghostly figure of psionic energy. As an action, you can transform into a transparent, ghostly version of yourself. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bonus Disciplines (Immortal UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Immortal feature.

At 1st level, you learn two additional Psionic Disciplines of your choice. They must be chosen from among the Immortal Disciplines.

Engine note: psionic disciplines are not in this data set yet. Note your chosen Immortal disciplines manually.

elements.name: Immortal Durability (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Immortal feature.

Starting at 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 per mystic level. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Resilience (UA)
elements.desc:
3rd-level Order of the Immortal feature.

Starting at 3rd level, your psionic energy grants you extraordinary fortitude. At the start of each of your turns, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 0) if you have at least 1 hit point.

elements.name: Surge of Health (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Order of the Immortal feature.

Starting at 6th level, you can draw on your psychic focus to escape death's grasp. As a reaction when you take damage, you can halve that damage against you. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Immortal Will (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Order of the Immortal feature.

Starting at 14th level, you can draw on your reserves of psionic power to survive beyond death. At the end of your turn while at 0 hit points, you can spend 5 psi points to immediately regain a number of hit points equal to your mystic level + your Constitution modifier.

elements.name: Bonus Disciplines (Nomad UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Nomad feature.

At 1st level, you learn two additional Psionic Disciplines of your choice. They must be chosen from among the Nomad disciplines.

Engine note: psionic disciplines are not in this data set yet. Note your chosen Nomad disciplines manually.

elements.name: Breadth of Knowledge (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Nomad feature.

At 1st level, you gain the ability to extend your knowledge. When you finish a long rest, you gain two proficiencies of your choice: two tools, two skills, or one of each. You can replace one or both of these selections with languages. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.id: Class Feature:Memory of One Thousand Steps (UA)
elements.name: Memory of One Thousand Steps (UA)
elements.desc:
3rd-level Order of the Nomad feature.

At 3rd level, you gain the ability to use psionics to recall your steps. As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you can teleport to an unoccupied space that you occupied since the start of your last turn, and the attack misses you. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Superior Teleportation (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Order of the Nomad feature.

At 6th level, you gain a superior talent for teleportation. When you use a psionic discipline to teleport any distance, you can increase that distance by up to 10 feet.

elements.name: Effortless Journey (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Order of the Nomad feature.

Starting at 14th level, your mind can mystically move your body. Once on each of your turns, you can forfeit up to 30 feet of your movement to teleport the distance you forfeited. You must teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

elements.name: Martial Training (Mystic UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Soul Knife feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with medium armor and martial weapons.

elements.name: Soul Knife Blade (Mystic UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Soul Knife feature.

Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to manifest a blade of psychic energy. As a bonus action, you create scintillating knives of energy that project from both of your fists. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Hone the Blade (Mystic UA)
elements.desc:
3rd-level Order of the Soul Knife feature.

Starting at 3rd level, you can spend psi points to augment your soul knife's attack rolls and damage. You gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls with your soul knives depending on the number of psi points spent, as shown on the table below. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Consumptive Knife (Mystic UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Order of the Soul Knife feature.

Starting at 6th level, whenever you slay an enemy creature with a soul knife attack, you immediately regain 2 psi points.

elements.name: Phantom Knife (Mystic UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Order of the Soul Knife feature.

Starting at 14th level, you can make an attack that phases through most defenses. As an action, you can make one attack with your soul knife. Treat the target's AC as 10 against this attack, regardless of the target's actual AC.

elements.name: Bonus Disciplines (Wu Jen UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Wu Jen feature.

At 1st level, you learn two additional Psionic Disciplines of your choice. They must be chosen from among the Wu Jen disciplines.

Engine note: psionic disciplines are not in this data set yet. Note your chosen Wu Jen disciplines manually.

elements.name: Hermit's Study (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Order of the Wu Jen feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Arcana, History, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival.

elements.name: Elemental Attunement (UA)
elements.desc:
3rd-level Order of the Wu Jen feature.

Starting at 3rd level, when a creature's resistance reduces the damage dealt by a psionic discipline of yours, you can spend 1 psi point to cause that use of the discipline to ignore the creature's resistance. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Arcane Dabbler (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Order of the Wu Jen feature.

At 6th level, you learn three wizard spells of your choice and always have them prepared. The spells must be of 1st through 3rd level. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Elemental Mastery (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Order of the Wu Jen feature.

Starting at 14th level, if you have resistance to a type of damage, you can spend 2 psi points as a reaction when you take damage of that type to ignore that damage; you gain immunity to that damage type until the end of your next turn.
